description: Returns the league-wide NFL news feed across every tracked player, newest first: signings, trades, cuts, injuries and depth-chart moves, filterable by time, impact, position and team, paged with next_cursor. Use it for "what happened today/this week" or a team's or position's latest news. Basic plan and above.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

days.description: Lookback when since is omitted, 1-90. Default 7.
days.title: Days

impact.description: Impact tags, comma-separated: injury, transaction, role, general.
impact.title: Impact

position.description: Positions, comma-separated (QB, RB, WR, TE, K, DST).
position.title: Position

since.description: Only news after this time: ISO-8601 or unix seconds. Default: the last `days` days. Clamped to 90 days.
since.title: Since

team.description: Only this team's players. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

name: get_latest_news

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

news.description: Headlines across all tracked players, newest first, each tagged by impact.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

title: League-wide NFL news feed
